what: The sections of this article, each with a line and a paragraph, for showing what the reader has already read. Built by admin/build/summaries.py from admin/content/articles/summaries/.

sections.label: The opening
sections.line: Behaviour policies per feature, per fix and per resource, not only per agent or application.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Hand testers the feature's policy; it describes the feature; signed, it makes an attack a path outside it.

sections.label: Test a feature, not an app
sections.line: Test a feature with its behaviour policy, which is also its description; what changed is the policies' difference.
sections.para: A tool can build the test environment.

sections.label: Context decides
sections.line: The same behaviour is fine in one place and a problem in another; the feature policy carries the context.

sections.label: Enforce it everywhere
sections.line: Client checks cut the noise; signed policies on requests let server and observers spot paths outside them.

sections.label: The resource side
sections.line: A resource behaviour policy is everything a key or API allows; the gap to the feature's needs is the risk.

sections.label: Bugs, too
sections.line: A fix is a change of behaviour too: the path it closes and what it must not open.

sections.label: Agents, users and interfaces
sections.line: Agent and user policies are feature policies plus a workflow; policies become permission sets for custom interfaces.

sections.label: What comes next
sections.line: First uses: the factory's CI changes and keys injected by host; the ABP agent maps the rest.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: A proposal; client checks are not a boundary; request signing not built yet.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: Dictated 19 November 2026, building on application behaviour policies and abp.sgit.ai.
